title: Interpolate Curve Finalize Display
description: Fix interpolate curve command: preview shows correct Catmull-Rom curve but finalize leaves wrong points/lines.
summary: Fixed interpolate curve finalize display mismatch with preview. Root cause: committed geometry wireframe drew only the first tessellation segment (or a start–end chord) instead of the full Catmull–Rom polyline. Updated geometryWireEdgeSegments and collectGeometryEdgeSegments to emit all consecutive sample segments; aligned preview with nurbsDisplaySamplePoints; marked interpolate curves with through:true and fit BREP via sampled through-points; extended ensureTypologyObjectFromCreateDiff to bind wire/edge primitives.
